title: Death at the Old Cottage
intro_text: The Old Cottage has been a quiet spot in Willowbrook for years, known for its lush greenery and occasional whisper of gossip. Tonight, it is shrouded in mystery as someone's secrets have come to light.

locations.name: Copper Kettle Cafe
locations.description: A quaint little café where the air is thick and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills every corner, mingling with the warm chatter of patrons.

locations.name: Coach Yard
locations.description: Underneath the watchful gaze of a weathered old tree, this open space is a haven for late-night wanderers and the occasional lost soul. The cobblestones are etched with the paths of countless footsteps, each one carrying a story.

locations.name: Old Cottage
locations.description: A small, weathered cottage stands as a silent sentinel on the outskirts of town. Its windows are sealed tight, and even the most eager passerby is reluctant to knock.

methods.text: Method 1: tricked them into a dangerous meeting place at the Old Cottage at night.
Method 2: poisoned their evening tea at the Copper Kettle Cafe.
Method 3: sabotaged their cart on the main road, and they never came back.
Method 4: sent them a forged note that pulled them away at night.

motives.text: Motive 1: keep a stolen land deed hidden from the town.
Motive 2: punish them for a public humiliation.
Motive 3: end a feud that had been simmering for years.
Motive 4: stop an old letter from being read aloud.
